# Real Hibachi

> Real Hibachi is a private hibachi chef & mobile teppanyaki catering service. A professional hibachi chef comes to your home, backyard, or event space with a mobile grill, fresh ingredients, and a live cooking show — setup, entertainment, and cleanup included.

## Service & Pricing

- Standard Plan: $59.90 per adult, $29.95 per child (under 13), $599 minimum per event
- Weekday Saver (California only): $45.90 per adult on select weekdays
- Each guest gets: 2 regular proteins (chicken, steak, shrimp, salmon, or tofu), garlic butter fried rice, fresh vegetables, and house salad
- Premium upgrades: filet mignon, lobster, scallops
- Optional table/chair/tablecloth rental: $10 per person; utensils +$5 per person
- Optional full setup: +$15 per guest
- Booking: $19.90 deposit locks the date; balance due on the day of service (cash, Zelle, Venmo, or credit card with 4% fee)
- Cancellation: full deposit refund with 72+ hours notice; complimentary rain tent available
- All cooking is done outdoors (patio, balcony, deck, driveway, or under tents). Licensed and insured.
- Allergy-friendly: recipes free of nuts and sesame; gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan, and halal accommodations available

## Service Areas

- Southern California only: Los Angeles County, Orange County, San Diego County, Riverside County, San Bernardino County, Ventura County
